verdict.rationale: Chronicle Labs ingests production data and customer traces, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents no training opt-out, data-use policy, or model-training exclusion control. The only mention of training describes replaying captured events "for training and evaluation," which is not a user control to prevent training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
